messages:
kai: heads-up — while wiring the Next + LlamaIndex agent starter I hit an auth retry difference between node and edge builds. node refresh+retry works, edge never re-sends Authorization on retry so calls 401.
lin: rough. which SDK build?
kai: redwood-sdk@0.15.0-edge. behaviour repros in Chrome edge runtime and Cloudflare Pages functions.
ada: can you paste minimal repro or error?
kai: sure:
```
FetchError: 401 Unauthorized
    at fetchWrapper (packages/sdk/dist/edge.js:110:23)
```
lin: is the retry path cloning the original Request? some runtimes drop manually set headers on redirect/clone.
kai: yes — we clone and reuse req.headers. node uses http client so header survives. on the edge, the header disappears during redirect.
ada: quick mitigation: when retrying, rebuild the Request and explicitly pull the token from the tokenStore before sending. that guarantees the header is present.
lin: agreed. also we should document "dev patterns": static REDWOOD_API_KEY for quick local runs vs ephemeral refresh flow for eval/CI. new hires keep stumbling on which to pick.
kai: added a tiny repro script in the starter that forces token expiry and a test using msw + jest.useFakeTimers() to make it deterministic. PR #478 opened.
ops-bot: CI: PR #478 failed  e2e snapshot flake on /agent route.
lin: flaky timer? switch to fake timers and advanceTimersByTime to avoid races.
kai: switched to fake timers, added an assertion that the final request includes Authorization header with the new token. updated README with a short "Auth modes" section.
ops-bot: CI: PR #478 passed all checks (build 7124) :white_check_mark:
ada: nice. once merged, we should backport the small retry helper to other samplekits (vite-react, ssr-starter) and add a one-paragraph troubleshooting note in the eval-harness runbook about token rotation traces.
kai: will do a follow-up PR to backport helper and add the runbook note. thanks for the quick reviews :thumbsup:
lin: great work — this should reduce onboarding friction for the agent starter and make the Local vs Ephemeral guidance clearer.
ops-bot: Announcement scheduled: post summary to #devex-docs after merge.
